builtins.name: fire
builtins.signature: fire(shape: int, color: int, x: fx, y: fx, speed: fx, angle: angle, xf: xform|none, task: sub|none) -> int
builtins.doc: 发一颗弹;shape/color 查外观表(越界/空格 编译期或 Fault);xf/task 为 xformdef/sub 名或 none;返弹句柄,失败 -1

builtins.name: batch
builtins.signature: batch(shape: int, color: int, x: fx, y: fx, n_angle: int, angle0: angle, angle_step: angle, n_speed: int, speed0: fx, speed_step: fx) -> int
builtins.doc: N-way 批量发环;shape/color 同 fire;返实际创建数

builtins.name: spawn_enemy
builtins.signature: spawn_enemy(x: fx, y: fx, hp: int, drop_table: int, score: int, sprite: int, task: sub|none) -> int
builtins.doc: 造敌;判定 12/16 默认;task 为敌主任务 async sub 名或 none(owner=新敌,敌死任务亡);返敌句柄,失败 -1

builtins.name: enemy_hp
builtins.doc: 查敌当前 hp;死/悬垂/越界句柄返 -1(P4-b;句柄是池 index,槽复用不可辨)——stage 编排等 boss 死用

builtins.name: drop_item
builtins.signature: drop_item(x: fx, y: fx, item_type: int) -> int
builtins.doc: 掉一颗道具(带随机喷发速度,消耗模拟 RNG);返句柄,失败 -1

builtins.name: move_to
builtins.signature: move_to(dur: int, x: fx, y: fx, easing: int)
builtins.doc: 敌自身(self owner 非 ENEMY → Fault)按 easing 缓动、dur 帧内平移到 (x,y);四参数皆真实压栈(不同于下方弹 setter 族的占位 handle 首参)

builtins.name: boss_set
builtins.signature: boss_set(slot: int, hp_ratio: fx, spell_id: int, timer_frames: int, phase_left: int, active: int)
builtins.doc: 整槽写 boss_ui 公告板(脚本写/UI 读);enemy 字段取自 self owner(非 ENEMY → NULL,不 Fault);符卡 active 期 enemy/spell_id/timer_frames/hp_ratio 由引擎逐帧自动覆写,phase_left 不受影响仍归脚本

builtins.name: pulse_signal
builtins.doc: 脉冲一条信号通道(边沿语义,仅当帧有效);放行处于弹变换 WAIT_SIGNAL 停驻态的弹(非 ECL 任务)

builtins.name: emit_req
builtins.signature: emit_req(id: int, a0: int|fx|angle, a1: int|fx|angle, a2: int|fx|angle, a3: int|fx|angle, a4: int|fx|angle, a5: int|fx|angle)
builtins.doc: 通道 B 渲染请求;void 只能裸语句;args 裸载荷(fx 过 raw/angle 过 BAM/int 原样)

builtins.name: rand
builtins.doc: 模拟 RNG 均匀 [0,n);确定性,随快照回卷

builtins.name: global
builtins.doc: 读 globals 槽(GVAR_RANK=0 为难度)

builtins.name: set_global
builtins.doc: 写 globals 槽;系统段(slot<16)脚本写为 no-op+计数,不 Fault(GVAR_RANK=0 建议脚本只读)

builtins.name: aim_player
builtins.doc: 自身(敌/弹属主)指向自机的 BAM 角

builtins.name: sin
builtins.doc: 查表三角,返 fx(VM op 直发,非 syscall)

builtins.name: cos
builtins.doc: 查表三角,返 fx(VM op 直发,非 syscall)

builtins.name: set_speed
builtins.doc: 弹 setter:改速率;作用于自身(self owner 非 BULLET → Fault);首参 handle 为占位求值后丢弃,不参与判定

builtins.name: set_angle
builtins.doc: 弹 setter:改方向;作用于自身(self owner 非 BULLET → Fault);首参 handle 为占位求值后丢弃,不参与判定

builtins.name: turn
builtins.doc: 弹 setter:转向增量;作用于自身(self owner 非 BULLET → Fault);首参 handle 为占位求值后丢弃,不参与判定

builtins.name: set_vel
builtins.signature: set_vel(handle: int, vx: fx, vy: fx)
builtins.doc: 弹 setter:直设速度向量;作用于自身(self owner 非 BULLET → Fault);首参 handle 为占位求值后丢弃,不参与判定

builtins.name: set_ang_vel
builtins.doc: 弹 setter:角速度;作用于自身(self owner 非 BULLET → Fault);首参 handle 为占位求值后丢弃,不参与判定(POLAR_FX:每帧 angle+=w)

builtins.name: set_accel
builtins.doc: 弹 setter:切向加速度;作用于自身(self owner 非 BULLET → Fault);首参 handle 为占位求值后丢弃,不参与判定(POLAR_FX:每帧 speed+=a)

builtins.name: set_gravity
builtins.signature: set_gravity(handle: int, gx: fx, gy: fx)
builtins.doc: 弹 setter:直角加速度;作用于自身(self owner 非 BULLET → Fault);首参 handle 为占位求值后丢弃,不参与判定(CART_FX:每帧 v+=(gx,gy);与 POLAR_FX 互斥)

builtins.name: stop_fx
builtins.doc: 弹 setter:停连续效果;作用于自身(self owner 非 BULLET → Fault);首参 handle 为占位求值后丢弃,不参与判定(清 POLAR_FX/CART_FX 连续效果)

builtins.name: aim_at_player
builtins.doc: 弹 setter:指向自机方向再加 offset 偏移角;作用于自身(self owner 非 BULLET → Fault);首参 handle 为占位求值后丢弃,不参与判定

builtins.name: spell_begin
builtins.signature: spell_begin(slot: int, spell_id: int, pattern: sub|none, time_limit: int, bonus0: int, flags: int, hp_threshold: int)
builtins.doc: 开卡:绑 boss/血线/计时/计分,spawn pattern 为卡绑定模式任务(随卡生死)

builtins.name: spell_end
builtins.doc: 手动收卡(取卡按血线自动判,通常不需要)

builtins.name: spell_timer
builtins.doc: 当前卡剩余帧数

builtins.name: add_score
builtins.doc: 给自机记分:delta 允许负(扣分),饱和钳 [0,u64::MAX] 不回绕;关底 bonus/结算记账用

builtins.name: bgm
builtins.doc: 声明当前 BGM:写世界锚点字段 bgm_id 并发 REQ_BGM;mark 跳入自动补偿最近声明(常量参)

builtins.name: bg
builtins.doc: 声明当前背景:写锚点 bg_id 并发 REQ_BG;换背景隐含新的 phase 纪元(补偿细则见 ecl-lang)

builtins.name: bg_phase
builtins.doc: 声明背景演出段号:写 bg_phase 并自动盖 bg_phase_frame=当前帧,发 REQ_BG_PHASE;表现层按段内局部时间 seek

builtins.name: clear_bullets
builtins.doc: 全场清弹:铺一个覆盖全场、存活 1 帧的消弹区(复用 FieldPool),每颗被消的弹原位转一颗星星(M0-15);不给护盾帧
